title: Crazy taxi but Venice
author: Key-Soft-8248
selftext:
Made a little game for fun. 

What should I add to it ?

comments.author: Major-Adeptness4671
comments.body: Love it. Maybe add some jumps?

comments.author: Key-Soft-8248
comments.body: Oh yep, once I hit some sort of bridge ( because there's like " high sea, low sea ) I was like " I should be able to jump ! And maybe grind the bridge or something haha )

comments.author: loontoon
comments.body: Nice idea. Will you be improving the graphics?

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body:
Yep but I think I want to try to recreate the ps1 style a bit ( as it's easier to do with AI ) 

Or I try to make the best three D I can with AI

What do you think ?

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
I can't create graphics, so I just buy ready made models.   

If you are happy with how it looks and how it plays, that is really all that matters.  

Will be interested to see you develop this further.

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body:
Oh yep that's also a possibility :) 

Will see, It's hard to finish projects, I just want to try too many game ideas with these new models lol

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
Sounds like you're young and not actually doing this as a job to support yourself.   
I guess most people in this sub are in that situation.

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body:
I am almost 40 but my day job is my street food shop so I don't have much time on the side with 2 kids also. 
And I enjoy the " creative " game design part ^^

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
That's cool.  I'm actually 59 and living in Bangkok.  Street food makes me think of either Thailand or Singapore :-)   
  
I think the concept of your game is great, and once you have the gameplay nailed I think it would be nice if you could increase the resolution of the graphics to make it look more commercial.

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body: I am French but wife is japanese so I cook Japanese street food ;). Thanks for the feedback ! Will explore what I can do for the graphics ^^

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body: Will be watching for your updates!

replies.author: promptling
replies.body: The idea flood is real with these models. I’d set one finish rule: a 10 minute loop with three fares that five strangers can complete, with no new mechanics until that build survives testing. Put every other idea in a “next prototype” list. I’m building [Patchloop](https://patchloop.io/) as a second home for unfinished AI built games so people can follow progress and help creators keep moving. This is exactly the finish-line problem it’s meant for.

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body: I like that idea ! Where do you talk about it ? Did you try on X ? Is it already live ? Like we can use it ? Do you have a community or not yet ? ( For sure we will have thousands of half baked AI games in the near future 😅 maybe we should all share GitHub repo so people can remix them

replies.author: promptling
replies.body: To be honest I absolutely suck at marketing. I only launched it yesterday. I can make you a mod on the site and whatever the best role we have currently. Trying to reward any of the first users and build relationships. I feel like this is the Wild West of the web all over again but for games. I don’t want any gatekeeping and I want to be immersed in the wave lol.

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body: ^^ let me check a bit the project / website and if I have ideas or else will tell you, I'll see how to put projects there also

comments.author: MistakeExotic6686
comments.body:
Very nice!

I did build a car system a while back when opus 4.6 came out

an impressive thing Claude can do is research find and download audios for a car engine, then implement them correctly , you can ask it to build a sound design configurator to help you pitch and modify the sounds to fit ur game's aesthetic

  
good job! looks good

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body: Thanks ! I did not know it could do that :)

comments.author: FreshnessAi
comments.body: Overall, it's niceI liked it but the effect that appears when the camera speeds up isn't quite right it's hard on the eyes. It might be better if you tweaked the lighting a bit.
